task: BAIR robot-pushing video prediction (iVideoGPT, aux1 camera, 256 test ep)
setting: gen_times=1 (fair same-setting); standard iVideoGPT BAIR recipe (138M config, lr1e-4 cosine, bs16, seg16/ctx1/res64, wd0.01, attn_drop0.1)
method: KDA = attention-surgery init from pretrained SDPA q/k/v/o + fresh gating + cross-layer AttnRes, then adapt (NOT from scratch)
verdict: near-parity: KDA O(N) linear-attn + AttnRes converges to FVD 122 vs SDPA 110 (+11% FVD, -0.6 psnr). Linearization retains ~90% quality; recovery curve 193->123->122 converged. Consistent with Attention Surgery/LinVideo.
notes: SDPA gen100 FVD=75.1 (paper 60.8); gen1 inflates FVD but is the fair same-setting compare. use_cache=False for KDA gen (correct, slow); proper O(1) KDA decode cache is TODO (the decode-efficiency contribution).
efficiency: separate benchmark: KDA fwd+bwd 2.47x faster than Flash-SDPA at 65k seq (O(N) vs O(N^2) compute); crossover ~32k
